notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.name: Auton Soldier
uses.cardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
